scripts.text: Chosen ones who are destined to become Gods
scripts.translation: 註定成為神明的選中者

scripts.text: are so many in this era
but they never realise their fate while alive.
scripts.translation: 可他們生前從未意識到自己的命運。

scripts.text: They end up to become ordinary men...
Wind and Clouds, please send this message to them,
scripts.translation: 風與雲啊，請把這段話傳達給他們，

scripts.text: who pursue food, clothing, shelter and wealth.
scripts.translation: 那些一生追逐衣食住行與財富的人。

scripts.text: Tell them they are wasting their time...
scripts.translation: 告訴他們，他們正在虛度光陰...

scripts.text: Tell them they forget the most important goal of the life...
scripts.translation: 告訴他們，他們忘記了人生最重要的目標...

scripts.text: Ooh hey! How's your singing these days?
scripts.translation: 哦，嘿！最近歌唱得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I wonder if your voice got any better.
You don't forget to spread good news in each town, right?
scripts.translation: 沒忘了在各個城鎮傳播好訊息吧？

scripts.text: And don't forget to learn new songs, too...
Never forget to have a positive attitude and the meaning of joy.
scripts.translation: 別忘了保持樂觀，也別忘了快樂的意義。

scripts.text: Our songs are supposed to deliver happiness and joy to everyone.
scripts.translation: 我們的歌聲，要把幸福與喜悅帶給每個人。

scripts.text: The sadness that overcomes my heart..
Is this the reason behind my troubles,
scripts.translation: 這就是我煩惱的緣由嗎，

scripts.text: is this why I am weak,
scripts.translation: 這就是我軟弱的原因嗎，

scripts.text: This must be why I cannot seem to forget you...
scripts.translation: 這一定就是我無法忘記你的原因...

scripts.text: Oh, sorry. I didn't see you because I was concentrating on writing some lyrics.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，我專心寫歌詞，沒注意到你。

scripts.text: Do you want to listen to my songs? Shall I sing a song for you?
scripts.translation: 想聽我的歌嗎？要不要給你唱一首？

scripts.text: I'm trying to compose a new song.

scripts.translation: 美麗的小姐，和我跳支舞吧~

scripts.text: How can a wanderer like me help you?
scripts.translation: 像我這樣的流浪者能幫你什麼？

scripts.text: Could you sing for me, please?
if you sing with a happy heart, your voice always gets better.
scripts.translation: 懷著快樂的心歌唱，嗓音自然會更動聽。

scripts.text: But, to Bards your voice is your life.
scripts.translation: 不過，對詩人來說，嗓子就是生命。

scripts.text: Sometimes your voice will go, but you must be careful.
scripts.translation: 有時候會失聲，所以一定要小心保護。

scripts.text: ^000088The sound of horses galloping over the horizon
The dust that covers the distant sun
scripts.translation: 揚起的塵土遮住遠方的太陽。

scripts.text: When thousands of eyes open in the night sky
scripts.translation: 當千萬雙眼睛在夜空睜開，

scripts.text: The castle's fire will burn with power.^000000
scripts.translation: 城堡的火焰將熊熊燃燒。^000000

scripts.text: ^000088I can hear.. the beating of my heart.
I can feel.. the blood rushing through my veins.
scripts.translation: 我能感覺到...血液在血管中奔湧。

scripts.text: .. and the weight of my armor.
This day will never come again!^000000
^000088Shake the sky and roar through the land.
Let the trumpets sound, and castle walls ring.
This moment will never come again!^000000
Hmm... that's always a good song to sing.
scripts.translation: 嗯...這首歌，唱起來總讓人痛快。

scripts.text: How was it? Don't you think it's a nice song?
Thanks! if you enjoyed my song, it makes me happy, too.
scripts.translation: 謝謝！你喜歡我的歌，我也很開心。

scripts.text: It would be nice if more people went around and sang...
scripts.translation: 要是有更多人四處歌唱，就好了...

scripts.text: Well, it's quite ok as it is now... hmmhmm.
scripts.translation: 不過，現在這樣也不錯...哼哼。

scripts.text: if you ever want to hear my song again, just ask.
scripts.translation: 如果你以後還想聽我唱歌，儘管開口。

scripts.text: Hmm... Did I lose my senses, I'll have to try harder.
scripts.translation: 嗯...難道我的感覺不靈了？得再努力點。

scripts.text: Oy, not requesting a song when you run into a Bard isn't very polite.
scripts.translation: 哎，遇見詩人卻不點首歌，可不太禮貌哦。

scripts.text: Well... can't help it since you look like you're in a hurry anyways.
scripts.translation: 不過...看你急著趕路，就算了。

scripts.text: Hunting is good... but you can't forget to relax once in a while.
scripts.translation: 打獵是好事...可也別忘了偶爾放鬆。

scripts.text: Youth is short and won't come again once it passes by..
How can a wanderer like me help you?
scripts.translation: 我這個流浪者，能幫你些什麼？

scripts.text: Could you sing for me, please?
Hoho, your voice is rather nice as well?
scripts.translation: 呵呵，你的嗓音也很不錯嘛。

scripts.text: Haha, nice attitude. You have to be like that to become a Bard.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，態度不錯！成為詩人，就得有這股勁頭。

scripts.text: I'll help you become a Bard then.
But before that... do you think you can bring me a Flower?
scripts.translation: 不過，先給我帶朵花，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I need to smell the scent of a Flower to feel like teaching.
scripts.translation: 聞到花香，我才有心情教你。

scripts.text: It doesn't really matter which Flower, but try to bring one that I like.
scripts.translation: 哪種花倒無所謂，不過，最好是我喜歡的。

scripts.text: And don't just buy any random Flower, ok?
scripts.translation: 可別隨便買朵花來敷衍哦。
哈哈，真是個膽怯的傢伙。

scripts.text: Don't think so little of yourself.
Come again if you change your mind.
Hmm... seems like you have some singing talents?
scripts.translation: 嗯...看來你有唱歌的天賦？

scripts.text: Don't just request songs.. singing to others is quite fun, too.
scripts.translation: 別光點歌，唱給別人聽，也很有趣。

scripts.text: Try enjoying your life as a Bard.
scripts.translation: 體驗一下詩人的生活吧。

scripts.text: You go from town to town, singing to the people. Doesn't it sound great?
scripts.translation: 走遍各個城鎮，為人們歌唱，聽起來很棒吧？

scripts.text: Hmm... I'm not sure what's what, but enjoy life.
scripts.translation: 嗯...不管怎麼回事，好好享受生活吧。

scripts.text: Well then~ Have a great time~
Did you bring a Flower? Let me see.
My friend Tchaikovsky used to like it.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友柴可夫斯基以前很喜歡它。

scripts.text: I wonder what he's doing now...
scripts.translation: 不知道他現在在做什麼...

scripts.text: It doesn't have a scent but it's a very moderate cute flower.
scripts.translation: 它沒有香味，不過是朵恰到好處的可愛小花。

scripts.text: The leaves gave me strength when I used to fall.
scripts.translation: 以前我倒下時，這花的葉子給了我力量。

scripts.text: I really like this flower, thank you.
Aloe... This is a rare flower.
How'd you get it? Rather skilled, eh?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼弄到的？挺有本事嘛。

scripts.text: The leaves are good and Aloe Vera is delicious, too..
scripts.translation: 葉子很不錯，蘆薈也很好吃...

scripts.text: but it's defnitely the most beautiful when it's a flower.
Ment... You can forget about all your hardships with one of these.
scripts.translation: 薄荷...有了它，你就能忘掉所有辛苦。

scripts.text: Nice to see it in such a long time!
scripts.translation: 好久沒見到它了，真令人懷念！

scripts.text: I heard you can make Anodyne with it...
scripts.translation: 聽說能用它製作麻醉劑...

scripts.text: But that would be a slight waste.. thanks!
scripts.translation: 不過，那可有點浪費...謝謝！

scripts.text: It's a dangerous yet beautiful flower...
scripts.translation: 這是一種危險卻美麗的花...

scripts.text: The deep purple charms a person..
Thank you, I really like this flower.
Ooh, a Witherless Rose. The strong flower that doesn't wither.
scripts.translation: 哦，不凋玫瑰。堅韌不枯萎的花。

scripts.text: Great to give to a girlfriend.
I wonder if it would be ok for a wanderer like me to accept it.
scripts.translation: 我這個流浪者，收下它合適嗎？

scripts.text: Haha, it should be ok.. right?
Frozen Rose... you can't really call this a flower,
scripts.translation: 冰凍玫瑰...嚴格說來，它算不上花，

scripts.text: But it is still beautiful... a clear Rose.
scripts.translation: 不過依然很美...是一朵清澈透明的玫瑰。

scripts.text: You can call it a flower even though it doesn't have a scent anymore.
scripts.translation: 雖然已沒了香氣，但仍稱得上是花。
那我就高高興興地收下了。

scripts.text: Oh, isn't this an Illusion Flower!?
Wow, how did you obtain such a rare flower!!
scripts.translation: 哇，你是怎麼弄到這麼稀有的花的！！

scripts.text: Than you very much, aah... I feel like heaven is in front of my eyes.
scripts.translation: 太感謝了，啊...彷彿天堂就在眼前。

scripts.text: What a wonderful feeling! I'm really happy!
Eh? This is just a normal flower.
I like it... but it's not enough.
You can get this flower from the girl in Prontera.
scripts.translation: 這花在普隆德拉的女孩那裡就能弄到。

scripts.text: Please bring me a different flower.
Oh no, you brought a Bouquet?
You can't bring me something like this.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼能帶這種東西來。

scripts.text: Go give this to a graduating Sage or something.
scripts.translation: 拿去送給畢業的賢者吧，很適合當畢業禮物...

scripts.text: Since it's great as that kind of gift... Bring a different flower.
Oy oy... did you go to a wedding or something?
scripts.translation: 喂喂...你是去參加婚禮了嗎？

scripts.text: What do you expect a guy to do with a Wedding Bouquet?
scripts.translation: 你覺得一個男人拿婚禮花束能做什麼？

scripts.text: It's not me. Go give it to a lady or something.
scripts.translation: 我可不要，拿去送給姑娘吧。

scripts.text: This isn't the type of flower I wanted.
It's nice... but this isn't good enough.
I like flowers that have a scent and are beautiful.
scripts.translation: 我喜歡既美麗又有香味的花。

scripts.text: I don't like fake flowers that go on top of heads.
scripts.translation: 我不喜歡戴在頭上的假花。

scripts.text: ...Agh, why'd you bring such a hideous thing?
scripts.translation: ...啊，你怎麼帶了這麼醜的東西來？

scripts.text: if you were trying to be funny, it was a good attempt...
scripts.translation: 要是想逗我笑，倒是做得不錯...

scripts.text: but bring a normal flower now.
scripts.translation: 不過，現在還是帶朵正常的花來吧。

scripts.text: Hmm? What... you didnt' bring anything.
Didn't I ask you to bring a flower?
scripts.translation: 我不是叫你帶一朵花來嗎？

scripts.text: Well... if you want to learn on your own, then so be it.
Anyone can just go out and sing.
As I promised, I'll help you become a Bard.
scripts.translation: 我答應過要幫你轉職為詩人。

scripts.text: But it's not easy my friend. Haha!
scripts.translation: 不過這可不容易，朋友。哈哈！

scripts.text: It is important to get to know a lot of people to learn how to sing.
scripts.translation: 學習歌唱，結識各式各樣的人很重要。

scripts.text: You must also keep up with all the things going on in different villages...
scripts.translation: 還得留心各個村莊發生的事...

scripts.text: There's a talking snowman in a town called Lutie.
scripts.translation: 薑餅城有個會說話的雪人。

scripts.text: Go there and bring back a present.
if you become friends with ^008800Jack Frost^000000, you will receive something.
scripts.translation: 和^008800傑克·弗羅斯特^000000交上朋友，就能得到東西。

scripts.text: And also talk to the townspeople while you're at it...
scripts.translation: 順便也和鎮上的居民聊聊...

scripts.text: How was the trip? Did you meet a lot of people?
scripts.translation: 旅途如何？認識了不少人吧？

scripts.text: You should have been able to learn something more important than a gift.
scripts.translation: 你應該學到了比禮物更重要的東西。

scripts.text: Then, do you want to try singing...?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你想試著唱一唱嗎...？

scripts.text: Eh, you still haven't become his friend?
if you become friends with ^008800Jack Frost^000000, you will receive something.
scripts.translation: 和^008800傑克·弗羅斯特^000000交上朋友，就能得到東西。

scripts.text: And talk with the village people, too...
scripts.translation: 也別忘了和村民們聊聊...

scripts.text: Hmm... this time you can do better, right?
Let's try again, you can do it.

Oy, You got the lyrics wrong!
Do a better job next time.
Wonderful! Finished it in one try!
You can become a great Bard.
Mmm... So you will not become a Bard.
scripts.translation: 嗯...看來你不會成為詩人了。

scripts.text: But I want to give you a souvenir...
scripts.translation: 不過，我還是想送你份紀念品...

scripts.text: Do you want to just change jobs now?
Or do you want a present.
I'd be thankful for a present.
Ah... Everything is good, but you still have some skill points left.
scripts.translation: 啊...其他都沒問題，可你還有沒用完的技能點。

scripts.text: Go learn the rest of the skills and come back.
And I am going to give you a small present...
It doesn't matter what kind, as long as they are 60 of the same kind...
scripts.translation: 哪種都行，只要同一種帶足60個...

scripts.text: Mmm? Seems like you haven't prepared all trunks the yet?
Do you want to just change jobs anyways?
Yes, just change my job already.
Very well! Hope you sing happy enjoyable songs.
scripts.translation: 很好！希望你唱出歡快動聽的歌。

scripts.text: Live like the wind and the clouds!
scripts.translation: 像風與雲一樣，自由地生活！

scripts.text: Hmm... very well, bring some trunks.
It doesn't matter what kind, as long as they are 60 of the same kind...
scripts.translation: 哪種都行，只要同一種帶足60個...

scripts.text: I will give you a gift once you bring them.
scripts.translation: 帶來之後，我就送你份禮物。

scripts.text: Good job. I will make you a job change souvenir with this.
scripts.translation: 做得好，我用這些給你做份轉職紀念品。

scripts.text: Here you go, a souvenir. It is useful when you sing.
scripts.translation: 給你，紀念品，唱歌時用得上。
